title: Penthouse October 2009 Ryan Keely Jeffrey Ross Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
description:
Penthouse magazine, October 2009. Complete w/ Centerfold. Pet of the Month: Ryan Keely.

Cover features: NFL Crib Sheet - previews and picks; Jeffrey Ross, the roast master; Inside the Church of Satan; Vampy vixen costume party; The Mile-High Club bachelor party report.

Back cover: Darksiders video game ad (Xbox 360 / PS3).

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
